notes.title: V 0.994 Final Test Update
notes.notes:
Fixed some description bugs
Replaced some music
Proofread the English translation problem
Fixed the bug that the volume of sound effects is not correct in some cases.
Supported steam deck (input method only supports English)
Added joystick vibration

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Fixed some game stuck due to some translation errors.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Fixed the bug where scroll wheel caused the UI to get stuck

notes.title: V0.981 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed the bug that some sound effects are not affected by settings

Fixed the bug that some interfaces are not affected by the mouse.

notes.title: Beta test Update V0.98
notes.notes:
The game now supports the use of the mouse for operations
Can now setup and load saves from the start menu.
Added the ability to retrain skills that have been awakened.
Now you can reload crafted materials by pressing R.
Fixed some text problems.
